title: Pulse Column: compact vertical model-route performance strip with burst estimator
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Console’s per-model and per-route lists are dense and don’t convey imminent cost spikes or short-duration latency bursts. Goal: design a compact, vertically-oriented card (Pulse Column) that can be tiled in lists and still surface: latency distribution, throughput trend, token composition, cost drift, and a 1–5 minute burst risk estimator. The component should: 1) fit into list rows (280px width), 2) be keyboard and screen-reader accessible, 3) allow quick variant comparison (A/B toggle), and 4) expand to a full inspector with microtrace lanes and rollouts controls. This ticket delivers high-fidelity chart specs, interaction notes, and a prototype for usability review.
chart_specs: Layout: vertical strip, fixed width 280px, paddings: 12px (top/bottom), 16px (left/right). Compact mode reduces padding to 8px.
Header: left-aligned model-route label (truncate after 2 lines), right-aligned small status pill (green/yellow/red). Click on header toggles expanded inspector.

Latency panel: compact violin + percentile ticks (p50/p95/p99). Violin height: 42px. Show median line and shaded 1–99% kernel. Color token: semantic 'latency-accent' (#2F66FF). SLO marker at top area dashed line (3rd decile).
Throughput panel: 24px high sparkbar showing requests/min across time range (default 1h). Bars downsampled to 60s buckets. Hover reveals exact rps and timestamp.
Token composition: stacked mini-area (30px height) showing prompt vs. completion token ratio; hover shows absolute counts and estimated per-token cost.
Cost drift overlay: semi-transparent heat band across sparkbar where unit cost changed >=10% in window. Color palette: amber->red for upward drift.

Burst estimator: small line with 90% confidence band (height 28px) projecting short-term expected peak given current scaling policy and observed queues. Tooltip includes assumptions (autoscale headroom, reserved slots).

Microtrace affordance: 8px clickable chevron that opens expanded inspector with microtraces swimlane aligned to timeline. Expanded inspector supports token-level waterfall, KV cache hits, and kernel selector debug row.
SLO badges: tiny inline badges for p95 SLO pass/fail with hover to see SLI windows and relevant alerts. Color tokens follow design system semantic statuses.
Data cadence & aggregation: default 60s cadence for sparkbars, percentile calc for violin over sliding 10m window. When dataset < 1m, show 'insufficient data' shimmer state.
Accessibility: sufficient color contrast (AA), all hover details accessible via keyboard focus and screen-reader-friendly aria-labels. Non-essential color cues supplemented with icons/text.

Interactions: hover shows tooltip, click header expands, right-click shows quick actions (open route, pin to board, compare variants). Keyboard: Enter expands, Space toggles variant A/B, Arrow keys move focus between tiles.
Performance budget: component render time < 50ms for 50 tiled rows on modern desktop. Prefer canvas rendering for violins and sparklines to reduce DOM nodes.
Design tokens: use --redwood-spacing-2 through -4, color tokens: --redwood-latency, --redwood-throughput, --redwood-cost-drift, --redwood-warning, and semantic status tokens.
Telemetry hooks: each expanded view emits 'pulse_expand' event with route/model id, variant, and time-range. Hover interactions are not sent to analytics to reduce volume.
Mobile adaptation: collapse sparkbars to single micro-sparkline and hide violin; tapping header opens full-screen inspector.
Exportable PNG: support export of expanded inspector as PNG with high-density token waterfall for postmortem attachments.

Suggested dataset fields from backend: timestamp, route_id, model_id, variant_id, rps, latency_p50,p95,p99, token_prompt, token_completion, cost_per_token, kv_cache_hit_rate, queue_depth, quantization_profile_id.
Fallbacks: when cost_per_token missing, show 'cost unknown' and disable cost-drift overlay; when kv metrics missing, hide KV row in expanded inspector.
Thresholds: warn at p95 > SLO*0.8 (amber), critical p95 > SLO (red). Allow per-team overrides in inspector settings.
Pixel specs: header font 13/600, body font 12/400, tiny helper 11/400. Card border-radius 8px, shadow elevation 2.
Exported variables for implementation: component width, collapsed/expanded heights, violin kernel bandwidth parameter, sparkbar bucket size mapping rule, color hex values, aria-label templates.
Edge case: for very spiky low-volume routes (avg rps < 0.1), show sample badge and link to trace explorer for raw logs.
Testing notes: include storybook stories for empty/nominal/spiky/cost-drift states and visual regression snapshots at 1x/2x DPI.
Rollout plan: 1) design review & accessibility pass, 2) Eng spike to validate data availability and perf, 3) canary in console beta orgs, 4) full release behind feature flag with telemetry gating.
Accept criteria: prototype validated in 3 usability sessions with PM/SEs, engineering sign-off on telemetry hooks and perf budget, automated snapshots passing.
